visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on an outdoor paved area during the day. A young woman stands on the left, wearing a light green quilted vest over a white long-sleeved shirt and light blue jeans featuring dark heart patterns. She talks and gestures toward a young man on the right. The man wears a black utility vest over a grey hoodie, dark trousers, and a black baseball cap worn backward. They stand near a low metal fence with trees and residential-style buildings visible in the background under an overcast sky. (2) The man reaches into his pocket and retrieves a silver smartphone. He holds it with both hands in front of him, beginning to interact with the screen. The woman leans her upper body toward him, her eyes focused intently on the device's display while she continues to speak and point. (3) The man begins a vigorous scrolling motion on the phone. The woman maintains her posture for a few moments, then stands upright, placing her hands on her hips. Her facial expression shifts from curiosity to a neutral, slightly bored look as she watches him repeatedly swipe his thumb across the screen. (4) A visual montage begins, showing the man alone in various medium shots. He is shown scrolling with extreme speed, at one point using a dramatic over-the-head 'casting' motion as if fishing to scroll through his photo gallery. The woman is no longer visible in these brief, rapid-fire cuts. (5) The camera returns to a medium shot of the man still hunched over his phone. He finally stops scrolling, his face lighting up with a smile. He looks up and turns the phone toward the space where the woman was previously standing, only to find the area empty. (6) The man looks around, his head turning from left to right with a confused and wide-eyed expression. He realizes he is alone. He then starts to jog quickly out of the frame in the direction the woman likely departed, still clutching his phone.
